title: Anthropic’s crypto futures traded 25% above its $81 billion IPO price as Bitcoin slumped 22%
summary: Crypto futures tied to Anthropic traded about 25% above the company’s IPO price on Thursday. The bets swelled during a Bitcoin selloff, but research from Block Scholes points to a broader retreat from risk rather than clear evidence that investors sold Bitcoin to buy Anthropic.
